# Agent notes — Claude-Code-Speckit-Plugin

This repository is a [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) plugin that bundles [GitHub Spec Kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit) under the [DgxSparkLabs](https://github.com/DgxSparkLabs) brand. It ships spec-kit templates, scripts, and workflow skills so a project can run the specification-driven workflow without installing Python or the `specify` CLI.

## Generated files — do not hand-edit

- **`README.md`** is generated by `scripts/generate_readme.py`. Do not edit it by hand. Regenerate with:

  ```bash
  uv run scripts/generate_readme.py
  ```

- **`assets/bash/`** is generated by [`.github/workflows/update-speckit-assets.yml`](.github/workflows/update-speckit-assets.yml). Do not edit it by hand. The daily workflow installs `specify-cli` at the latest stable spec-kit release and re-runs `specify init --script sh`. Top-level `skills/speckit-*` is a generated copy of `assets/bash/.claude/skills/speckit-*`; do not edit those copies by hand either.

## Bundled Spec Kit extensions

Bundled Spec Kit extensions are declared in [`speckit-extensions.txt`](speckit-extensions.txt) (one `specify init --extension` value per line; `#` comments and blank lines are ignored). The asset-update workflow reads that file and passes each entry as `--extension <value>`.

## Plugin init command

The plugin's init command lives under `skills/` (`skills/init`). `/speckit:init` always copies the pre-generated `.specify/` tree from `assets/bash/` into the user's project. It copies `.claude/skills/speckit-*` only in standalone mode, detected by the absence of `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` two levels above the init skill directory (an npx-installed `.claude/skills/init` has no such ancestor; a plugin install does). `--skills` / `--no-skills` override the detection. When the plugin is installed those skills are already provided, so they are skipped by default.

## Compat CI

Plugin registration, install, listing, and manifest validation run through:

- [`.github/workflows/compat-test.yml`](.github/workflows/compat-test.yml) — PR/push workflow that checks out the repo and invokes the composite action.
- [`.github/actions/plugin-compat`](.github/actions/plugin-compat) — installs the Claude Code CLI via the official installer, then registers this repo as a marketplace, installs the plugin, asserts both are listed, and runs `claude plugin validate ./`.
